identification: Four loose vintage Kenner Star Wars (1977-78 era) figures: Hammerhead x2, Walrus Man, Chewbacca. Chewbacca appears to be holding a small dark object in one hand (possibly a bowcaster, not confirmed). The left Hammerhead's head sits tilted, possibly loose or a poor neck join.

chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings (and Terapeak): 'Kenner Star Wars Hammerhead loose vintage', 'Kenner Star Wars Walrus Man loose vintage', 'Kenner Star Wars Chewbacca loose vintage' (check with and without bowcaster, original vs repro, Hong Kong/Taiwan/Hong Kong-made marks), and 'vintage Star Wars figures lot loose'. Also AFA/Heritage Auctions and LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable results for loose 1977-78 Kenner figures; Australian Palitoy/Kenner are different makers, check markings.
viewing_check: Check the marks on the lower back/legs (First 1977 Kenner Prod. Inc. / LFL, country of origin). Confirm Chewbacca's object is a genuine bowcaster or not. Check the left Hammerhead's neck for breakage or glue, paint wear, loose joints, and any signs of reproduction (soft detail, wrong plastic colour). Check Walrus Man's colours and whether the figures are original rather than later reissues.
rate_note: All database prices are AUD, no conversion used.
